notes.title: Ver.1.12（2022.12.03）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. System - Timeline EX (8) is added. Under EX mode, special challenges can be conducted and more powerful equipment can be obtained according to the difficulty of the challenge
2. Level - The structure of the level has been adjusted to prevent the character from rushing out of the terrain when the speed is too fast
3. Level - The current level will generate clues that have not been obtained
4. Operation - optimized the operation of the term extraction interface
5. System - fixed the problem that enemies in the dead state will be affected by skills
6. Skill - Now you can enter the temporary invincibility when casting martial arts
7. Skill - adjusted the cooling time of splitting and bleeding
8. Skill - fixed the problem that the damage bonus of BUFF will be lost when life is continuously restored
9. Game balance - non percentage damage abnormal states are no longer affected by abnormal state resistance
10. Treasure - Affixes that are now green circles will gain additional attribute bonus

notes.title: Ver.1.09（2022.9.30）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Level - Revamped the 3rd Level, improving the overall gameplay. More levels will be improved.
2. System - New Feature - Wall Jumping is added. Now you could jump one more time once you land on a wall.
3. Enemy - Now invulnerable enemies' attack will no longer get interupted.
4. Skills - Fixed an issue that caused latest added skills will get affected twice by other damage boosts
5. Character - Fixed an issue that caused players unable to move after doing a drop attack around edges

notes.title: Ver.1.08（2022.9.26）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Gameplay - Timeline 7 added, alongside with Item level VII.
2. Level - The location of the level destination is now randomed, instead of fixed to the right side.
3. Balance - Reduced the range of Ningu
4. Balance - Reduced the upper limit of cooldown
5. Keybindings - Improved the Attribution menu, fixed the keybinding issues on PC
6. Skill - Air Dash no longer locked to flying units
7. Enemies - Fixed the issue that caused the Relentless and Redhood Assassin vanished due to loss of collision
8. Display - Added different colored effect for Kunai and Shuriken, making it easier to distinguish
9. Others - Added a new Boss fight to the opening, allowing new players to learn about the game mechanics

notes.title: Ver.1.07（2022.9.23）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Level- Redesigned Level 2, improved the overall gameplay. More levels will be polished.
2. Display - Fixed an issue that caused the Talent menu failed to show as intended
3. Speedrun - Fixed an issue that Pause menu is unavailable when death
4. Mugen Phantom - Fixed an issue that caused this mode has 1 level only
5. Sound - Improved the sound effect in game, and adjusted some volume issue.
6. Balance - Wishes cost will now gradually increase
7. Balance - Nerfed the potency of several passive skills

notes.title: Ver.1.06（2022.9.22）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Gameplay - Added 4 more melee Passives abilities.               
2. Gameplay- Now changing in timeline will also change the enemies set.                                       
3. Leaderboard- now it will demonstrate rankings within 10 days.                                                       
4.Text- Fixed some visual errors with English localization.                 
5. Level- Fixed some level issues

notes.title: Ver.1.05（2022.9.21）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Controller - Fixed an issue that caused switching between keyboard and controller would result in controller unavailable
2. Settings - Changing settings will no longer exit the game
3. Settings - Added the key bindings for Controllers
4. Speedrun - Fixed the issue that continue after death will enter the First Level

notes.title: Ver.1.04（2022.9.20）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Level - Revamped the first level, improving the jumping design. More levels will be improved base on player experience
2. Level - Added unique Soundeffect for pre-boss portal
3. Level- Revamped the enemies design for Level 6, now there be no more than 3 elites together
4. Balance - Shielded enemies will no longer block during attack
5. Speedrun - Deleted 1st and 6th level in random pool
6. Speedrun - Improved anti-cheat system
7. System - Exit added for Mugen Phantom
8. Text - Fixed some visual error within Leaderboard's ID

notes.title: Ver.1.03（2022.9.19）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Level - Fixed the issue that some obstacles did not work properly
2. Level - Fixed an issue that caused dark shade covering the screen sometimes
3. Text - Improved the localization text
4. Enemy - Azrael no longer has collision with players
5. System - Fixed the issue that Holy Grail buff went missing sometimes
6. System - Improved the loot drop order for Hidden Boss Fight
7. System - Now player's position within minimap is more centered
8. Balance - Blessing of Invincibility will not get spent by traps quickly
9. System - The "Restart" on Main Menu is now changed to "Additional Mode"

notes.title: Ver.1.02（2022.9.18）Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Enemy- Increased the hitbox for BAT
2. Enemey- Adjusted the Skeleton Shieldbearers' attack range, it will no longer dmg area behind it.
3. Enemy- fixed the issue that caused Redhood Assassin get stucked during attack animation
4. Enemy- Reduced the dmg and charge range for Unyielding Soul, and it will no longer keep chasing player
5. System- Improved the hitbox of jumping on the platform
6. System- Fixed an issue causing players get stucked into walls sometimes
7. System- Opening Chest will no longer bind with attack key
8. System- Reduced the map size, generally speedup the game pace.
9. Balance- Reduced the coin drop for final level, while increased the soul drop rate and amount.

notes.notes:
1. Added the option to adjust the size of minimap
2. Added the configuration type for Controllers
3. Fixed several issues within levels
4. Fixed the issue that caused some missing conversations
5. Now you could observe the level through RS on controller
6.  Faster Recover animation for landing
